summary: The registrant filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 23, 2026, reporting exploration drill results from the Florida Canyon Mine in Nevada, including 0.48 g/t Au over 54.9 m at the Madre Shear North Target and 1.30 g/t Au over 62.5 m in the Central/Radio Tower Saddle. No special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist, strategic review, spin-off, or management change—is disclosed. The filing provides operational updates only. Risk-arb angle: none; this is a mining exploration update with no deal terms or corporate-action mechanics.
